import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_34/test_0.csv"
]

# List to hold dataframes from all sources
dfs = []

# Load each source file, rename the column to match target schema, and append to list
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    # Rename 'J_CALL' to 'V_GENE' to match target schema
    df_renamed = df.rename(columns={"J_CALL": "V_GENE"})
    dfs.append(df_renamed)

# Concatenate all dataframes (in this case only one, but scalable)
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Export the transformed dataframe to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_34/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
